headline: Mikel Merino's late strike sends Spain into World Cup semifinals
summary: La Roja beat Belgium 2-1 in a dramatic quarterfinal in Los Angeles, with super-sub Merino scoring the winner in the 88th minute.
details: Spain secured a place in the World Cup semifinals after a 2-1 victory over Belgium in a tense quarterfinal clash in Los Angeles.
Mikel Merino continued his habit of scoring decisive late goals, netting the winner in the 88th minute just two minutes after coming off the bench.
Fabian Ruiz had initially put Spain ahead in the 30th minute, but Belgium equalized before halftime through a header by Charles De Ketelaere in the 40th minute.
The match remained locked at 1-1 until the final moments when Merino pounced on a rebound from a Pau Cubarsi shot to seal the win.
The defeat marks a poignant end for Belgium's 'golden generation,' including stars like Kevin De Bruyne and Romelu Lukaku, who have chased a major trophy for over a decade.
Spain will now face an unbeaten France in the semifinals in Dallas this Wednesday, seeking their first World Cup title since 2010.
caption:
The super-sub strikes again! Mikel Merino nets a dramatic late winner to send Spain to the World Cup semifinals.

Spain secured a place in the World Cup semifinals after a 2-1 victory over Belgium in a tense quarterfinal clash in Los Angeles.

Mikel Merino continued his habit of scoring decisive late goals, netting the winner in the 88th minute just two minutes after coming off the bench.

Fabian Ruiz had initially put Spain ahead in the 30th minute, but Belgium equalized before halftime through a header by Charles De Ketelaere in the 40th minute.

The match remained locked at 1-1 until the final moments when Merino pounced on a rebound from a Pau Cubarsi shot to seal the win.

The defeat marks a poignant end for Belgium's 'golden generation,' including stars like Kevin De Bruyne and Romelu Lukaku, who have chased a major trophy for over a decade.

Spain will now face an unbeaten France in the semifinals in Dallas this Wednesday, seeking their first World Cup title since 2010.

headline_marked: Malaysia to [[form drone unit to catch illegal immigrants]]
headline: Malaysia to form drone unit to catch illegal immigrants
summary: The Malaysian authorities are establishing a specialized drone unit to enhance border security and track down undocumented migrants.
details: Malaysian authorities are in the process of forming a specialized drone unit specifically designed to track and apprehend illegal immigrants.
This move is part of a broader effort to strengthen border surveillance and prevent unauthorized entry into the country.
The use of advanced drone technology will allow security forces to monitor remote and difficult-to-reach areas more effectively.
By deploying these drones, the government aims to reduce the illegal crossing of borders and improve the overall security of the Malaysian territory.
caption:
Malaysia is turning to high-tech surveillance to secure its borders.

Malaysian authorities are in the process of forming a specialized drone unit specifically designed to track and apprehend illegal immigrants.

This move is part of a broader effort to strengthen border surveillance and prevent unauthorized entry into the country.

The use of advanced drone technology will allow security forces to monitor remote and difficult-to-reach areas more effectively.

By deploying these drones, the government aims to reduce the illegal crossing of borders and improve the overall security of the Malaysian territory.
